# Lob Physical Mail Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that sends physical mail through Lob's API: postcards and letters generated from templates, address verification, and delivery tracking. Test API keys are free and simulate everything — live keys send real mail that real post offices deliver, billed per piece — so the skill requires an explicit confirmation with the exact cost before any live send, and never sends automatically. Address verification keeps undeliverables (and wasted postage) down. Uses Lob API keys, kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from Lob's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. No secrets in the repo.
